title: LLMLL Trust Report JSON Emit Schema
description: Shape of the JSON emitted by `llmll verify --trust-report --json`. Emit-only — the compiler never re-parses this artifact. Versioning is independent of the source JSON-AST schema (docs/llmll-ast.schema.json); the source `schemaVersion` and this `trust_report_version` track different surfaces. Consumers (e.g. the repair-loop harness) should pin to a major version of `trust_report_version`. Additive-only changes within a major version; breaking shape changes bump the major. v1.1.0 (OBLIG-PBT-3, v0.10.5) added parallel `tier_profile_pre` and `tier_profile_post` aggregates plus an optional `stale_downgrades` array, all additive over v1.0.0.

trust_report_version.description: Trust-report emit schema version. Independent of the source-program `schemaVersion` field on JSON-AST inputs.

entries.description: Per-function trust entries. One entry per def-logic / letrec across the entry module and the imported module cache.

summary.description: Pre-existing six-Int counts plus a drift total. Predates v0.10.4. Preserved unchanged; the new `tier_profile` aggregate sits alongside, not replacing.

tier_profile.description: v0.10.4 (R6d) — fixed-arity six-Int tier-count aggregate over per-function effective tier classifications. Never reduced to a scalar (LLMLL.md §4.4.1:344 declares contract_checked ‖ tested incomparable; the load-bearing diamond is preserved by refusing total order). Classification uses the diamond meet of pre and post per entry: a function with pre=contract_checked and post=tested has effective level `asserted` and increments only `asserted`, not both `contract_checked` and `tested`.

tier_profile_pre.description: v1.1.0 (OBLIG-PBT-3) — per-pre-clause tier-count aggregate. Each entry contributes by its per-clause effective level (the pre-clause evidence record meeting the transitive-callee effective level). Distinct from the scalar `tier_profile` which uses the per-function meet of pre and post. Optional in v1.1.0 to preserve back-compat for v1.0.0 strict-validation consumers; populated on every v1.1.0+ emit.

tier_profile_post.description: v1.1.0 (OBLIG-PBT-3) — per-post-clause tier-count aggregate. PBT-derived `tested` evidence is structurally post-only (the PBT-Lift rule at LLMLL.md §4.4.5 targets `csPost` only); downstream consumers reading the post-side empirical signal should consume this aggregate rather than the diamond-collapsed scalar `tier_profile`. Optional in v1.1.0 to preserve back-compat for v1.0.0 strict-validation consumers; populated on every v1.1.0+ emit.

stale_downgrades.description: v1.1.0 (OBLIG-PBT-3) — per-clause diagnostic strings for sidecar evidence records whose `pbt_witnesses` did not match any live property-body hash on read. Each downgrade reflects a `DLTested → DLAsserted` strict downgrade of a stale cached entry. Optional; empty array when no downgrades occurred.

suppressions.description: v0.6 weakness-ok declarations: (function name, reason). Acknowledges intentional contract gaps.

drifts.description: Total epistemic drift warnings across all entries. Not a tier — a violation count on the tier classification.

TierProfile.description: Six-Int aggregate of per-function effective tier classifications. Component-wise dominance is the only legitimate partial order; never total-ordered into a scalar.

verified.description: Functions whose effective level is `verified` (body-faithful SMT proof). See LLMLL.md §4.4.1.

proved.description: Reserved for a future Lean-discharged tier. Zero by construction in v1.0.0 emits — no DLProved constructor exists in the compiler's DisplayLevel ADT yet. Forward-compatible slot so the field shape is stable across future tier additions.

contract_checked.description: Functions whose effective level is `contract-checked` (SMT proof of pre⇒post consistency, body not encoded). Incomparable with `tested` per the diamond lattice (LLMLL.md §4.4.1:344).

tested.description: Functions whose effective level is `tested` (PBT passed N samples, no static proof). Incomparable with `contract_checked` per the diamond lattice.

asserted.description: Functions whose effective level is `asserted` (runtime assertion only). Includes the diamond meet `contract_checked ⊓ tested = asserted` when pre and post sit in incomparable branches.

no_contract.description: Functions with no contract clauses at all. Distinct from `asserted`, which has clauses but no static evidence.

LevelLabel.description: Human-readable level label as emitted by `dlLabel` (Syntax.hs). Examples: `"verified (liquid-fixpoint)"`, `"verified (lean)"`, `"contract-checked (z3)"`, `"tested (100 samples)"`, `"asserted"`. JSON `null` when the corresponding clause is absent.
